datasets.name: ChEMBL bioactivity database

checked.method: GET landing_url; ChEMBL REST target/search, assay/search, activity and molecule/search counts

variables_present: connexin targets (human GJB1 CHEMBL4879427: 5 activities; GJB2 CHEMBL4295738: 74; GJA1 CHEMBL4680024: 92)
assay descriptions mentioning gap junction (281 hits; first three are 'Inhibition of rat glial cell gap junction at the concentration of 50 uM' style)
halothane CHEMBL931: 85 activity records across all targets
variables_missing: coverage of the general anesthetic list
dye-transfer uncoupling as a structured field for most anesthetics
datasets.scope: medicinal-chemistry records, mostly mammalian; 3 connexin targets found by target search, all Homo sapiens
datasets.evidence: REST responses: target search 'connexin' total_count 3; assay search 'gap junction' total_count 281; halothane molecule CHEMBL931 found; activity counts as listed.

datasets.name: IUPHAR/BPS Guide to Pharmacology

checked.note: landing page HTTP 200; services endpoints HTTP 401 (API key required)

variables_missing: web-service access to target and ligand lists
datasets.scope: curated pharmacology portal; web services require registration
datasets.evidence: Landing page HTTP 200, but both web-service calls returned HTTP 401 with message 'API key is missing'; no annotation was retrieved.

datasets.name: PubChem compounds and bioassays

checked.method: GET landing_url; PUG REST compound name lookup; E-utilities esearch db=pcassay

datasets.scope: compound and assay archive across species; assay hits not inspected individually
datasets.evidence: PUG REST: halothane -> CID 3562; esearch pcassay term "gap junction" count 149.

search_log.note: first three hits are rat glial cell gap junction inhibition assays
plant side is sparse in the literature

summary: ChEMBL and PubChem hold mammalian connexin assays and compound records (e.g. halothane), but there is no structured table of anesthetic-by-gap-junction-coupling and no plant-side data; the IUPHAR web services need an API key, so they were not queried.
next_step: Compile a fixed list of animal and plant anesthetics and extract coupling measurements from the literature (Europe PMC lists 219 papers on halothane and gap-junction uncoupling); add plasmodesmata papers for the plant arm.
obstacles_confirmed: Gap-junction uncoupling is not a structured field for most anesthetics.
Plant anesthesia data are sparse: 4 Europe PMC hits for anesthetic plus plasmodesmata plus gap junction.
